adjudication.rationale: In lib/tasks/disqus.thor the PR removes `method_option :category` and all logic that looked up `category_id` and passed it to `PostCreator` (`category: category_id`). The refactor now calls `TopicEmbed.import_remote(user, t[:link], title: t[:title])`, and neither `TopicEmbed.import_remote` nor `TopicEmbed.import` accepts/sets a category (it calls `PostCreator.new(user, title: ..., raw: ..., ...)` without `category`). This makes Disqus imports always use the default category and drops the previously supported `-c/--category` behavior without any warning.
